three.js r160 - official git tag r160 of github.com/mrdoob/three.js (MIT, see three.LICENSE).
Files: three.module.min.js (build/), OrbitControls.js (examples/jsm/controls/).
The npm registry was blocked (HTTP 403 policy) in the build sandbox, so the same r160 files were taken from the git tag.
Inlined into index.html by tools/build_prototype_data.py (ES-module export/import rewritten to a function body; loaded lazily on the first 3D use).
